description: Unit tests for the litellm module, specifically testing the preservation of 'retry-after' headers in custom error classes like BadGatewayError, ServiceUnavailableError, and InternalServerError, as well as their inclusion in exception types and attribute correctness.

classes.name: BadGatewayError
classes.description: Custom error class for HTTP 502 Bad Gateway errors, with attributes to preserve response info and headers.

classes.name: ServiceUnavailableError
classes.description: Custom error class for HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors.

classes.name: InternalServerError
classes.description: Custom error class for HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.

methods.name: test_bad_gateway_error_preserves_retry_after_header()
methods.description: Tests that BadGatewayError preserves the 'retry-after' header from the response.

methods.name: test_service_unavailable_error_preserves_retry_after_header()
methods.description: Tests that ServiceUnavailableError preserves the 'retry-after' header.

methods.name: test_internal_server_error_preserves_retry_after_header()
methods.description: Tests that InternalServerError preserves the 'retry-after' header.

methods.name: test_bad_gateway_error_in_exception_types()
methods.description: Checks that BadGatewayError is included in the exception types list.

methods.name: test_bad_gateway_error_attributes()
methods.description: Verifies that BadGatewayError contains expected attributes and string representations.

methods.name: test_exception_without_response_headers()
methods.description: Ensures error handling works when response or headers are None.

methods.name: test_exception_with_empty_headers()
methods.description: Checks error behavior with empty response headers.
